locator.text: Equation (B.38), p. 156, in the proof of Proposition B.8

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The right-hand equality is literally the Lean definition body: `separation T C P = Real.exp T / (C * P) ^ 10`, with Lean's `T` the paper's T_sh, `P` the paper's P_*, `C` the amplitude. The left-hand equality x_sep = X_sep/X_R is stated in Lean in multiplied form, `resetRadius_mul_separation : resetRadius Xi C P * separation T C P = Xi * Real.exp T`; since X_R = resetRadius Xi C P = X_i(CP_*)^{10} > 0 and the paper's X_sep is X_i e^{T_sh} (page 155, 'We also set X_sep = X_i e^{T_sh}'), dividing that identity by X_R gives x_sep = X_sep/X_R. Nothing else differs: same exponent 10, same base CP_*, same numerator e^{T}.
